question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Trailing four-quarter operating cash flow is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} against trailing net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}, so the operating-cash-flow-over-net-income ratio of {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} cannot be read as coverage: the fiscal 2025 goodwill impairment ("Fiscal 2025 goodwill impairment of 301185000, all in the Electronics segment") pushed trailing income below zero. The company's own history is {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for fiscal 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for fiscal 2024, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for fiscal 2023 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for fiscal 2022; before the impairment years cash covered income comfortably. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, against {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} for fiscal 2025 (the lowest of the five filled years) and {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} for fiscal 2024; strongly negative accruals here mean cash ran well ahead of book income because of non-cash charges, not that income is inflated. The nearest clean quarterly reading, the first quarter of 2026, is {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the highest of the two filled quarters and above {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} a year earlier, meaning income and cash nearly matched in that quarter; in the quarter this 10-Q reports, operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} ran ahead of net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}. Working capital: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} year over year on the balance sheet while the cash-flow statement's trailing change is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}, an articulation gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}; inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} against a cash-flow change of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}; payables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} against a cash-flow change of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}. All three gaps run the same way, balance-sheet growth larger than the cash-flow line, which is what an acquisition does: the Basler opening balances ("inventory 20703000, receivables 14739000" in the purchase-price allocation) entered the balance sheet without passing through the operating section, and translation moved the rest. The share-of-net-income ratios ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income}) are not interpretable because the denominator is a trailing loss. Within the six months, the cash-flow statement shows receivables absorbing more cash than a year earlier, inventory absorbing cash where it released cash a year earlier, and accounts payable supplying cash where it consumed cash a year earlier ("| Accounts payable |  | 39,159 |  |  | (7,001) |  |"); MD&A attributes the operating cash flow increase to "higher cash earnings" and says nothing about payables. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: income moves more than cash, not less, because the fourth-quarter impairments of fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025 sit in net income and not in operating cash flow; there is no sign of income being smoothed against cash.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash exceeds income and no accrual inflation is visible; the trailing ratios are distorted by non-cash impairments, the working-capital gaps trace to the acquisition, and payables supplied part of the period's operating cash

revenue_recognition.finding: Days sales outstanding on trailing revenue and average receivables is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. On the company's own annual history the fiscal 2025 figure of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} was the highest of the five filled years, up from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2024 and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2023, and receivables over revenue at {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} was likewise the highest of five years. The quarterly view is more benign: the quarter this 10-Q reports carries days sales outstanding of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest of the six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} at its high point in the third quarter of 2025; receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables} grew with revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year, not ahead of it. Contract liabilities move against revenue: deferred revenue is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} at the quarter end against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier, but it fell from the year-end and first-quarter balances while revenue rose ("Deferred revenue 4989000 at 2026-06-27 against 11215000 at 2025-12-27 and 6713000 at 2026-03-28.") and the cash-flow change in contract liabilities turned negative ("The cash-flow change in contract liabilities is -4308000 for the six months against 2844000 a year earlier."); the ratio to revenue of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} is small and still the second highest of six quarters, so the effect on revenue is minor but the direction is adverse. The allowance netted against receivables is mostly a reserve for sales discounts and allowances ("reserve for sales discounts and allowances of 74553000 at 2025-12-27, and an allowance for credit losses of 2520000"), which is variable consideration; its ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} is the second lowest of six quarters, below {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} five quarters back, and the fiscal 2025 ratio of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} was the lowest of five years; a thinning variable-consideration reserve while distributor-channel revenue grows lifts recognised revenue at the margin. MD&A names "favorable price" as a driver in Electronics alongside volume; gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the highest of six quarters, consistent with that. MD&A states no change in critical accounting policies; no new judgement area (principal versus agent, standalone selling price, bill-and-hold, extended payment terms) appears in the text carried, and fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested because no fourth quarter is derived in the record.
revenue_recognition.verdict: no recognition-policy change and receivables track revenue this quarter, but the variable-consideration reserve is thinning and contract liabilities fell against rising revenue, a mild adverse tilt

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Inventory reserve: the ratio of reserve to net inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}, the third lowest of six quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} at its high in the third quarter of 2025; the reserve balance of {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} fell while net inventory rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory} ("Inventory valuation reserves 80530000 at 2026-06-27 against 82695000 at 2025-12-27 and 83593000 at 2026-03-28."). The fiscal 2025 ratio of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} was the highest of five years, so the thinning is from a high base, and the reserve may have been consumed by disposals at the two semiconductor sites being closed; but no inventory write-down is tagged for the period and the prose does not say. Sales-allowance thinning is in the revenue area. Warranty: no warranty accrual is tagged in any period, so that ratio cannot be assessed. Goodwill: at the fiscal 2025 test the Industrial Controls unit's "fair value exceeded its carrying amount by 0.22" and "Electronics Passive Products and Sensors 0.87" after the fiscal 2025 impairment, and Dortmund Fab goodwill was impaired within a year of acquisition; goodwill remains the largest soft asset. The Basler measurement-period adjustments cut acquired intangibles, inventory, receivables and PP&E and raised goodwill ("As a result of these adjustments, goodwill was increased by $8.6 million."); moving value from amortisable and depreciable assets into goodwill lowers future amortisation and depreciation, an estimate change that raises income, and the allocation is still "not yet finalized". Tax: "The 10-Q tags the quarter's effective tax rate as 0.236 against 0.267 a year earlier" and the six-month rate fell likewise; the note attributes the fall to "lapses in the statute of limitations for previously unrecognized tax benefits and excess tax benefits for share based compensation recognized in 2026", discrete items rather than a lower structural rate, while the trailing effective rate in the calculator is held at {tax_rate} because trailing pretax income is depressed. Deferred tax expense swung to a charge ("Deferred income tax expense of 10026000 for the six months to 2026-06-27 against a benefit of -807000 a year earlier.") after the valuation allowance rose in fiscal 2025 on German losses; no valuation-allowance release is reported. Impairment: fixed assets of the two semiconductor sites were written down using unobservable inputs ("classified within Level 3 of the fair value hierarchy"), and PP&E of {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} is below {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment} a year earlier; the measurement rests on management's estimate. Pension: the expected one-time settlement charge is now placed in the first quarter of 2027, whereas the first-quarter 10-Q tagged the same range for the third quarter of 2026, a charge pushed later. Employee-related accruals fell from the year-end balance ("Current employee-related liabilities 107717000 at 2026-06-27 against 114662000 at 2025-12-27.") while MD&A names higher annual incentive expense as an SG&A driver; the first-quarter payout of the prior year's bonus is the benign reading, but the accrual is lower against a higher expense. In the 10-K, the noncurrent allowance on receivables ninety days or more past due rose against a year earlier with no explanation in the input. No estimate change that releases a reserve into income is disclosed.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: reserves are thinning from high bases and the tax rate fell on discrete items; goodwill headroom is thin in two units and the acquisition allocation is still moving value into goodwill; no reserve release into income found

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalised development cost is not tagged in any period ("the companyfacts record tags none of us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAdditions in any period"), so no capitalisation against expensed research and development can be measured; research and development expense over the trailing four quarters is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}, rising year to date, and is expensed. Soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the third highest of six quarters, after the first-quarter high of {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}; the fiscal 2025 figure of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} was the third highest of five years. The rise comes from Basler goodwill and intangibles, and the measurement-period shift of value from intangibles, inventory and PP&E into goodwill (estimates area) defers cost by lowering future amortisation and depreciation. 'Non-recurring' items recur: "| Restructuring, impairment, and other charges |  | 20,021 |  |  | 2,506 |  |  | 27,443 |  |  | 11,525 |  |", and the 10-K tags restructuring, settlement and impairment provisions in each of fiscal 2023, fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025 at rising amounts; the company's own per-share non-GAAP adjustment widened ("| EPS impact of Non-GAAP adjustments (below) |  | 0.70 |  |  | 0.55 |  |  | 1.06 |  |  | 0.99 |  |"), and the credit agreement was amended so that restructuring and business optimisation expenses are added back to covenant EBITDA. The purchase-accounting inventory step-up is also added back in the adjusted figures. The trend table's non-GAAP gap is insufficient because no non-GAAP measure is tagged, so the widening rests on the release's own reconciliation. Trailing operating margin is {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} against a three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}, the gap being these charges.
cost_deferral.verdict: no capitalisation of costs is visible, but the recurring 'non-recurring' charges and the widening non-GAAP gap mean adjusted earnings overstate sustainable earnings

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: no proceeds from sale of receivables are tagged in any period, and supplier-finance obligations, unconditional purchase obligations and guarantee exposure are likewise untagged, so none can be measured and the filing text carried mentions none. Payables: the cash-flow statement's payables line supplied cash this year where it consumed cash a year earlier ("| Accounts payable |  | 39,159 |  |  | (7,001) |  |"), the trailing four-quarter change is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}, and days payables outstanding stand at {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}; the prose does not discuss it, and an adjustment removes this working-capital source from quality-adjusted free cash flow. Classification: the sale of the Polytronics equity investment is booked in investing under "Net proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment, and other" and the realised gain sits in other income, so it lifts pretax income but not operating cash flow; Basler indebtedness of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.this_year_to_date.value} paid as consideration is classified as an acquisition payment in investing; an asset held for sale from Basler was also sold into the same line. The release's "All other cash provided by financing activities" inflow is unexplained there, while MD&A reports net proceeds from stock-based award activities of a different figure; both are financing and neither touches operating cash, but the two documents do not reconcile the line. Leases: operating lease liability is stated only at the fiscal year end ({ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}); no variable-interest entity appears in the text carried. Share-based compensation over the trailing four quarters is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, rising against the company's own history ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation}); it is a real cost and is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, the difference being mostly the Basler purchase. Debt fell to {terms.debt_now} from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} and net debt is {ratios.solvency.net_debt}; the covenant EBITDA definition was widened in the first quarter of 2026.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: no factoring or supplier finance visible; payables supplied cash and a non-operating gain sits in pretax income; classification is otherwise orderly

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: The 10-Q's controls section reports disclosure controls effective with no change in internal control over financial reporting; no auditor review report, risk-factor diff, subsidiary-list diff or SEC comment letter is in the input, so auditor change, critical audit matters and subsidiary-list changes cannot be assessed from this quarter. The filing history carries "an NT 10-K filed 2025-02-27 (0001140361-25-006294) for the period ended 2024-12-28" (a late annual report a year earlier), "an Item 4.01 8-K filed 2023-08-16" (an auditor change, historical), "an Item 1.01/2.03 8-K filed 2026-03-13" (the amended credit agreement) and "Item 5.02 8-Ks filed 2026-01-08, 2026-03-05 and 2026-04-28", officer or director changes whose roles are not in the input, so a chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller departure can be neither confirmed nor excluded. Quiet revisions of prior-period values: for Basler acquisition-date goodwill "The 10-K tags it as 152343000; both 10-Qs tag it as 160977000", with intangibles and net assets also different; the prose explains measurement-period adjustments, which are permitted, but the earlier value was re-tagged at a different context date without a restatement trace. Separately the fiscal 2025 10-K "tags cost of goods and services sold for fiscal 2024 (2023-12-31..2024-12-28) with an adjustment of 12300000 on the ScenarioAdjustmentMember" and "It is paired with an InventoryNet adjustment of -12300000 at 2024-12-28.", a prior-period adjustment with no explanation in the input. Related parties: purchases from ATEC, an equity-method investee, rose year to date; the amounts are small against cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. A customer fuse recall is carried as a loss that is reasonably possible with no accrual and no estimable range.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: controls reported effective; two quiet prior-period revisions, a cluster of officer-change filings and a prior late annual report are the signals to watch

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K earnings release matches the 10-Q on every figure both carry: trade receivables, inventories, accounts payable, long-term debt, restructuring and impairment charges, diluted earnings per share, the effective tax rate, six-month operating cash flow and the cash-flow lines for receivables, inventories and payables all agree, and the release's second-quarter operating cash flow equals the calculator's quarter figure of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}. Of the thirty-two notes items carrying an expected direction, the numbers confirm most (listed in the reconciliation), leave unresolved those that look forward (third-quarter guidance, record bookings, collar gains) or that no fact isolates (Europe volume, the quarter placement of the statute-lapse tax benefit, the indemnification reversal), and contradict none. Cross-document gaps: the release places the statute-lapse benefit in the first quarter while the 10-Q cites the same lapses as a driver of the three-month rate; the release attributes passenger-vehicle weakness to "lower global passenger car builds" while MD&A attributes it to "the strategic exit of certain lower margin products"; MD&A attributes the operating cash flow rise to "higher cash earnings" while the statement shows payables supplying cash; the release's "All other cash provided by financing activities" line is unexplained while MD&A names stock-award proceeds of a different figure; "record bookings" appears only in the release; the indemnification receivable reversal appears only in the release; and the pension settlement charge that the notes reader could not date-compare is shown by the tags to have moved from the third quarter of 2026 to the first quarter of 2027.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: release and 10-Q agree on the numbers; the disagreements are in attribution and timing, none in amounts

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: days sales of inventory are {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} on trailing cost of revenue and {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} for the quarter, the lowest of six quarters and well below the fiscal 2025 figure of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, so inventory is turning faster; the build is in raw materials and work in process while finished goods fell ("raw materials 198883000 against 186662000, work in process 137394000 against 131129000, finished goods 178008000 against 181376000"), which fits demand rather than unsold product. Against that, the reserve ratio thinned to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} and the closure or disposition of two semiconductor manufacturing sites was accompanied by a fixed-asset impairment only, with no inventory write-down tagged for the period; the obsolescence exposure of those sites' inventory is not addressed in the text carried. Purchase commitments in excess of need: unconditional purchase obligations are not tagged in any period and the text carried does not state them, so nothing can be found either way. Customer concentration: the 10-K tags Arrow Electronics at {concentration.facts.8.value|pct} of revenue in fiscal 2025 against {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} in fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} in fiscal 2023, China at {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.4.value|pct}, and non-US sales at {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}; China net sales rose in the quarter. A distributor near a tenth of revenue means channel inventory and the sales-discount reserve matter. Channel stuffing: quarterly days sales outstanding at the low of six quarters and receivables growing in line with revenue argue against it; the thinning sales-discount reserve and the fall in deferred revenue are the only channel signals pointing the other way, and both are small. Circular or vendor-financed deals: the related-party table shows purchases from three equity-method investees (ATEC, Powersem, EBTech) and small sales to Powersem; the company invests in suppliers, not in customers that then buy from it; the Polytronics investment was sold; no customer financing, loans to customers or investments in customers appear in the text carried.
industry_lens.verdict: inventory is turning faster and concentration is moderate; the open items are the untagged purchase commitments and the closed sites' inventory

reconciliation.why: the 10-Q tags the fixed-asset impairment and the restructuring and impairment line rose against the prior-year quarter and six months, as the note states.
net PP&E fell from the year-end balance and the impairment is tagged on assets held for use, as expected for a write-down.
the 10-Q tags negative measurement-period adjustments to acquired inventory, PP&E and intangibles; the receivables adjustment is stated in prose only but runs the same way.
the goodwill roll-forward tags goodwill acquired in Industrial for the six months and the tagged adjustment matches the prose.
the allocation values moved between the 10-K and the 10-Qs, consistent with an allocation still open.

the six-month payment to acquire businesses tagged in the cash-flow statement, {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.this_year_to_date.value}, is the amount the note describes as Basler indebtedness paid.
a realised gain is tagged for the quarter, the fair-value table no longer lists equity securities, and proceeds from sale of PP&E and other rose sharply.
proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment rose against a year earlier, consistent with the held-for-sale and Polytronics proceeds in that line.
the tagged forecast range matches, and the tags show the period moved from the third quarter of 2026 to the first quarter of 2027, the comparison the notes reader could not make.
the tagged quarterly and six-month rates fell against the prior year.
the first-quarter rate was lower than the second-quarter rate, consistent with a first-quarter benefit, but no fact isolates the statute-lapse amount by quarter.
no tagged 10-Q fact carries the reversal; the only figure is the release's own footnote, and the 10-Q text does not mention it.

net sales rose {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} and net income {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year; the earlier expectation is not in the input, so the size of the beat is not testable.
forward guidance; no reported figure exists yet.
no bookings fact is tagged and the statement appears only in the release.
the release's covenant schedule adds back impairment and restructuring and reports leverage far below the trigger.
the release states the same increase and trailing dividends paid are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid}, up year to date.

the release shows a large 'all other' financing inflow where there was an outflow a year earlier and diluted shares rose; the release's line and MD&A's figure are not the same amount and neither document reconciles them.
SG&A rose as stated; employee-related accrued liabilities nonetheless fell from the year-end balance.
Electronics net sales rose year over year.
gross profit rose and the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the highest of the six filled quarters.
Electronics segment operating income rose sharply on higher sales.
Transportation operating income and margin fell despite higher sales.
auto sensor net sales fell year over year.
the decline is confirmed by the auto sensor sales fact; no number can say whether the cause is car builds or a strategic exit, so the attribution difference stays open.
the Industrial operating margin fell while segment sales rose.
Industrial net sales rose and the release and pro forma facts attribute most of the increase to Basler.
the record tags China, the United States and other countries; other countries rose, and no fact isolates Europe or its semiconductor and passenger-car volume.
the foreign exchange line turned from a loss to a gain in the quarter and year to date.
operating cash flow rose as stated and net income rose with it; the statement also shows payables supplying cash while receivables and inventory absorbed it, which the prose omits.
no fact for the reclassification of accumulated other comprehensive income is in the record, and the item looks forward.
interest expense and interest paid already fell year over year, though the driver in the numbers is debt repayment rather than the swap.

The Basler purchase-price allocation brought in "inventory 20703000, receivables 14739000" and current liabilities that never pass through the operating section, and translation moved the rest; the gaps are the size and sign an acquisition produces.

The quarter this 10-Q reports shows {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest of six quarters, so the year-end build has not extended; the prose does not discuss collection terms.

anomalies.name: contract liabilities fell against rising revenue
anomalies.what: Deferred revenue fell from the year-end and first-quarter balances while revenue rose ("Deferred revenue 4989000 at 2026-06-27 against 11215000 at 2025-12-27 and 6713000 at 2026-03-28."), and the cash-flow change in contract liabilities turned negative; the balance now is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier and the ratio to revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}. The amounts are small next to revenue, but a falling contract liability during a revenue surge means prepaid orders were recognised faster than new ones were taken.

anomalies.name: sales-allowance reserve ratio thinning
anomalies.what: The allowance netted against receivables is mostly the reserve for sales discounts and allowances ("reserve for sales discounts and allowances of 74553000 at 2025-12-27, and an allowance for credit losses of 2520000"), a variable-consideration estimate. Its ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}, the second lowest of six quarters, below {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} five quarters back; the fiscal 2025 ratio of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} was the lowest of five years. The allowance balance of {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} grew, but more slowly than gross receivables; a thinner allowance on rising distributor sales lifts recognised revenue at the margin.

anomalies.name: inventory reserve ratio thinning as inventory builds
anomalies.name_ko: 재고가 늘어나는데 재고 충당금 비율은 축소
anomalies.what: The reserve-to-inventory ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} at its high; the reserve of {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} fell while net inventory rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory} ("Inventory valuation reserves 80530000 at 2026-06-27 against 82695000 at 2025-12-27 and 83593000 at 2026-03-28."). The fiscal 2025 ratio of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} was the highest of five years, so the base is high; no inventory write-down is tagged for the period and the prose does not explain the fall.

anomalies.name: effective tax rate lowered by discrete items
anomalies.what: "The 10-Q tags the quarter's effective tax rate as 0.236 against 0.267 a year earlier" and the six-month rate fell likewise; the note attributes it to "lapses in the statute of limitations for previously unrecognized tax benefits and excess tax benefits for share based compensation recognized in 2026". Both are discrete; the excess tax benefit follows the large stock-award exercises. The lower rate raises reported income without a lower structural rate. Its amount is not a calculator field, so no adjustment can be written.

anomalies.name: Basler measurement-period shift of value into goodwill
anomalies.name_ko: Basler 측정기간 조정으로 영업권으로 이동한 가치
anomalies.what: Measurement-period adjustments cut acquired intangibles, inventory, trade receivables, PP&E and other long-term assets and raised goodwill ("As a result of these adjustments, goodwill was increased by $8.6 million."); the 10-Q tags the intangibles, inventory, PP&E and goodwill adjustments. Value moved from assets that amortise, depreciate or flow through cost of sales into goodwill that does not, which lowers future expense; the allocation is still "not yet finalized".

anomalies.name: goodwill headroom thin after impairments
anomalies.what: At the fiscal 2025 test the Industrial Controls unit's "fair value exceeded its carrying amount by 0.22" and "Electronics Passive Products and Sensors 0.87" after that unit's impairment; Dortmund Fab goodwill was impaired within a year of acquisition. Goodwill remains the largest soft asset and soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}. The prose of this 10-Q carries no interim test and no new trigger; Transportation margins fell in the quarter.

anomalies.name: pension settlement charge pushed to next year
anomalies.what: The note now expects the "settlement charge in the first quarter of 2027 estimated between $6 million and $8 million"; the tags show "The first-quarter 10-Q tagged the same range for 2026-06-28..2026-09-26, so the forecast period has moved later." The range is unchanged; the charge to earnings is deferred by two quarters and the reason is not stated.

anomalies.name: incentive expense up while the employee accrual is down
anomalies.name_ko: 성과급 비용은 늘었는데 종업원 관련 부채는 감소
anomalies.what: MD&A names "higher annual incentive expenses" as an SG&A driver, and SG&A rose; yet "Current employee-related liabilities 107717000 at 2026-06-27 against 114662000 at 2025-12-27." The year-end balance had itself jumped against the prior year-end. The benign reading is the first-quarter payout of the prior year's bonus; a higher expense with a lower accrual is nonetheless a pairing to watch.

anomalies.name: fixed-asset impairment measured on unobservable inputs
anomalies.name_ko: 관측 불가능한 투입값으로 측정한 유형자산 손상
anomalies.what: The two semiconductor sites' assets were written down using inputs "classified within Level 3 of the fair value hierarchy"; the impairment is tagged and PP&E of {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} sits below {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment} a year earlier. The size rests on management's estimate of the sites' value, and an announced closure implies further exit costs.

anomalies.name: noncurrent past-due allowance rising
anomalies.what: In the fiscal 2025 10-K, "AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableNoncurrent on the 90-days-or-more past-due member is 9300000 at 2025-12-27 against 3800000 at 2024-12-28." No prose in the input explains the tag or the rise; a growing long-dated past-due balance while the current allowance ratio thins is worth watching.

anomalies.name: deferred tax expense swing after the valuation-allowance rise
anomalies.name_ko: 평가충당금 증가 이후 이연법인세 비용 전환
anomalies.what: "Deferred income tax expense of 10026000 for the six months to 2026-06-27 against a benefit of -807000 a year earlier." follows "Deferred tax asset valuation allowance of 97557000 at 2025-12-27 against 55468000 at 2024-12-28." on German losses. No release is reported; the trailing calculator rate is held at {tax_rate} because trailing pretax income is depressed. The swing is not explained in the text carried.

anomalies.name: 'non-recurring' charges recur and grow
anomalies.what: "| Restructuring, impairment, and other charges |  | 20,021 |  |  | 2,506 |  |  | 27,443 |  |  | 11,525 |  |" this quarter, and the 10-K tags restructuring, settlement and impairment provisions in fiscal 2023, fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025 at rising amounts. The company's per-share non-GAAP adjustment widened ("| EPS impact of Non-GAAP adjustments (below) |  | 0.70 |  |  | 0.55 |  |  | 1.06 |  |  | 0.99 |  |"). Trailing operating margin is {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} against a three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}. Adjusted earnings exclude a cost that has appeared every year.

anomalies.name: soft-asset share near its high
anomalies.what: Soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the third highest of six quarters, after the first-quarter high of {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}; fiscal 2025 was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}. Basler goodwill and intangibles drive it, and the measurement-period shift into goodwill adds to it. Benign reading: an acquisition-led balance sheet, not capitalised operating cost.

anomalies.name: covenant EBITDA now adds back restructuring
anomalies.name_ko: 구조조정 비용을 가산하도록 바뀐 약정 EBITDA
anomalies.what: "The Credit Agreement was amended in Q1 2026 and now allows to add restructuring charges and business optimization expenses in addition to the prior credit agreement." The amendment coincides with the rise in restructuring and site-closure charges; leverage remains far below the trigger, so the effect is on the definition, not on compliance.

anomalies.name: equity-sale gain in pretax income
anomalies.what: "The 10-Q tags a realized gain on equity securities (Polytronics) of 7400000 for the quarter." The proceeds sit in investing under "Net proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment, and other" and the gain in other income, so operating cash flow is untouched but pretax income and net income for the quarter include a one-time non-operating gain. The amount is not a calculator field, so no earnings adjustment can be written.

anomalies.name: 'all other' financing inflow unreconciled
anomalies.what: The release shows "| All other cash provided by financing activities |  | 72,179 |  |  | (813) |  |" with no breakdown, while MD&A states "The Company received $75.6 million of net proceeds related to stock" award activities; the two figures are not equal and neither document reconciles the line. Diluted shares rose ("diluted shares 25620000 against 24905000"). Both are financing, so operating cash is unaffected, but the inflow is dilutive and one-off.

anomalies.name: commitments, guarantees and supplier finance untagged
anomalies.what: Proceeds from sale of receivables, supplier-finance obligations, unconditional purchase obligations and guarantee maximum exposure are all absent from the record in every period ("the companyfacts record tags none of us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation in any period"), and the text carried does not mention any of them. Operating lease liability is stated only at the fiscal year end at {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}. Off-balance-sheet exposure cannot be sized from this input.

anomalies.name: share-based compensation rising
anomalies.what: Trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, above {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2024 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2023. It is a real cost paid in shares; it is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} and its excess tax benefit lowered the reported tax rate.

anomalies.name: Basler debt paid as consideration in investing
anomalies.what: "The Company paid $0.3 million and $2.8 million of indebtedness as part of the purchase consideration during the three and six months ended June 27, 2026, respectively." The six-month payment to acquire businesses is tagged at {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.this_year_to_date.value} in investing. Paying an acquiree's debt as consideration is orderly; it is listed because it keeps the payment out of financing and the release's net credit-facility line.

anomalies.name: Basler goodwill revised between filings
anomalies.what: "The 10-K tags it as 152343000; both 10-Qs tag it as 160977000." for Basler acquisition-date goodwill, with intangibles and net assets also different and the two context dates a day apart. The prose explains measurement-period adjustments, which are permitted; the earlier filed value was nonetheless replaced without a restatement trace in the record.

anomalies.name: prior-period cost-of-sales and inventory adjustment
anomalies.what: The fiscal 2025 10-K "tags cost of goods and services sold for fiscal 2024 (2023-12-31..2024-12-28) with an adjustment of 12300000 on the ScenarioAdjustmentMember" and "It is paired with an InventoryNet adjustment of -12300000 at 2024-12-28." A prior-year cost of sales raised and inventory lowered by the same amount is a correction of a prior period; no explanation is in the input and no restatement trace was printed.

anomalies.name: cluster of officer-change filings
anomalies.what: The filing history shows "Item 5.02 8-Ks filed 2026-01-08, 2026-03-05 and 2026-04-28", three officer or director changes in four months, with no bodies in the input. Whether a chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller left cannot be told from this record.

anomalies.name: prior late annual report and auditor change
anomalies.what: The filing history lists "an NT 10-K filed 2025-02-27 (0001140361-25-006294) for the period ended 2024-12-28" and "an Item 4.01 8-K filed 2023-08-16". Both are historical; this 10-Q was filed on time and reports controls effective. They are listed because a late annual report a year earlier and an auditor change two years earlier are part of the company's own filing history.

anomalies.name: related-party purchases rising
anomalies.what: "Purchases from ATEC (a 24% equity-method investee) are 5000000.0 for the six months to 2026-06-27 against 3300000 a year earlier"; purchases from Powersem and EBTech fell. The amounts are small against trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}; the growth is listed, not the size.

anomalies.name: statute-lapse benefit placed in different quarters
anomalies.name_ko: 공소시효 만료 세금혜택의 분기 배치 불일치
anomalies.what: The release footnote says "including $2.7 million of tax benefits due to lapses in the statute of limitations for previously unrecognized tax benefits recognized in the first quarter of 2026", while the 10-Q tax note cites the same lapses as a reason the three-month rate fell. "The first-quarter 10-Q tagged 0.223 for 2025-12-28..2026-03-28." and the second quarter is tagged higher, consistent with a first-quarter benefit, but no fact isolates the amount by quarter.

anomalies.name: passenger-vehicle decline attributed differently
anomalies.name_ko: 승용차 매출 감소 원인의 문서 간 차이
anomalies.what: The release says "Passenger vehicle sales were impacted by lower global passenger car builds and auto sensor product declines." while MD&A says the decline was "driven by the strategic exit of certain lower margin products". The auto sensor sales fact confirms the decline; nothing in the numbers says whether it was the market or a choice. One framing is external and temporary, the other elective and lasting.

anomalies.name: operating cash flow attribution omits working capital
anomalies.what: "The increase in net cash provided by operating activities of $78.2 million was primarily due to higher cash earnings." The statement shows receivables absorbing more cash than a year earlier, inventory absorbing cash where it released cash before, and payables supplying cash where they consumed it before; the trailing payables change is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}. Net income did rise, so the attribution is incomplete rather than wrong.

anomalies.name: pension charge timing moved between filings
anomalies.name_ko: 공시 사이에 옮겨진 연금 정산비용 시점
anomalies.what: The notes reader could not tell whether the expected quarter had moved because the prior wording was not in its input; the tags answer it: "The first-quarter 10-Q tagged the same range for 2026-06-28..2026-09-26, so the forecast period has moved later." The prose gives no reason for the move.

anomalies.name: 'record bookings' only in the release
anomalies.what: The release expects growth "supported by record bookings, continued customer momentum, and contributions from the Basler acquisition"; the 10-Q paragraphs carried do not mention bookings and no bookings or backlog fact is tagged. The demand claim behind next quarter's guidance rests on the release alone.

anomalies.name: indemnification reversal absent from the 10-Q text
anomalies.what: The release states "2026 included the reversal of an indemnification receivable of $2.7 million related to lapses in the statute of limitations for previously unrecognized tax benefits recognized in the first quarter of 2026"; the 10-Q tax note and MD&A cite the statute lapses but not the reversal, and no fact tags it. The tax benefit and the offsetting other-income charge are disclosed together only in the release.

anomalies.name: site closures without an inventory write-down
anomalies.what: The closure or disposition of two semiconductor manufacturing sites brought a fixed-asset impairment ("the Company recognized fixed asset impairment charges of $13.1 million, primarily related to the announced closure and/or disposition of two manufacturing sites for the semiconductor business") but no inventory write-down is tagged for the period and the reserve ratio fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}. Days of inventory at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} are the lowest of six quarters, which is reassuring on the whole; the closed sites' inventory is the unaddressed piece.

anomalies.name: distributor and China concentration
anomalies.what: Arrow Electronics was {concentration.facts.8.value|pct} of fiscal 2025 revenue against {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} in fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} in fiscal 2023; China was {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.4.value|pct}; non-US sales were {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}. China net sales rose in the quarter. A distributor near a tenth of revenue makes the sales-discount reserve and channel inventory matter, and the reserve ratio is thinning.

anomalies.name: purchase commitments untagged
anomalies.what: Unconditional purchase obligations are absent from the record in every period and the text carried does not state them, so purchase commitments in excess of need cannot be tested. With inventory rising to {terms.balances_now.inventory} and two semiconductor sites closing, the size of any take-or-pay commitments would matter.

adjustments.name: payables supplied operating cash
adjustments.quote: Change in accounts payable provided 39,159 (thousands) of operating cash in the six months to 2026-06-27, against a use of 7,001 a year earlier. Balance-sheet accounts payable is 248,972 against 211,079 at 2025-12-27.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 영업현금흐름 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}는 순이익을 크게 웃돌지만, 후행 사분기 순이익 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}이 2025 회계연도 영업권 손상차손 때문에 마이너스여서 비율 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}은 해석할 수 없다. 매출채권·재고·매입채무의 대차대조표 변동과 현금흐름표 변동의 차이는 Basler 인수로 설명되며, 매입채무 증가가 이번 기간 영업현금의 일부를 공급했다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 이번 분기 매출채권 회수기간은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮아 매출채권이 매출을 앞서지 않는다. 다만 판매할인·공제 충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}로 얇아지고 이연수익 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}가 매출 증가와 반대로 줄어든 점은 작지만 불리한 방향이다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 재고 충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}로 전분기 {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}보다 낮아졌고, 실효세율 하락은 공소시효 만료와 주식보상 초과세혜택 같은 일회성 항목 때문이다. Basler 측정기간 조정으로 무형자산·재고·유형자산 가치가 영업권으로 옮겨져 향후 상각비가 줄고, 연금 정산비용은 2027년으로 미뤄졌다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 태그되지 않아 측정할 수 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용 처리된다. 그러나 '비경상' 구조조정·손상 비용이 매년 반복되며 커지고 회사의 비GAAP 조정폭도 넓어져, 후행 영업이익률 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}은 삼 년 평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}를 밑돈다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망금융은 태그되지 않았고 본문에도 없다. 매입채무가 전년 현금 사용에서 올해 현금 공급으로 바뀌어 후행 사분기 변동 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}를 품질조정 잉여현금흐름에서 차감했으며, 주식보상비용 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}은 실제 비용으로 이미 차감되어 있다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 보고됐고 감사인 검토보고서는 입력에 없다. 10-K와 10-Q 사이에 Basler 인수일 영업권이 조용히 수정됐고, 10-K에 2024 회계연도 매출원가·재고 조정이 설명 없이 태그됐으며, 2026년 초 세 건의 임원 변경 8-K가 있다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표와 10-Q는 두 문서가 함께 싣는 모든 숫자에서 일치하며 분기 영업현금흐름 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}도 같다. 불일치는 금액이 아니라 설명에 있다: 세금혜택의 분기 배치, 승용차 매출 감소의 원인, 영업현금흐름 증가의 원인, 그리고 연금 정산비용 시점이 2026년 세 번째 분기에서 2027년 첫 번째 분기로 옮겨진 점이다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고 회전일수가 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮아 재고가 빨리 돌고 있으나, 반도체 공장 두 곳 폐쇄에 재고 평가손실은 태그되지 않았다. Arrow Electronics 비중은 {concentration.facts.8.value|pct}, 중국 비중은 {concentration.facts.7.value|pct}이며, 구매약정은 태그되지 않아 판단할 수 없고 고객에 대한 순환거래 징후는 없다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
